title: Helion Energy outline button
description: A 48px outlined rectangle with small 4px corners and a 13px label. On hover a faint wash fills it and the label rolls up as a copy rolls in from below; optionally the outline opens from the middle and the label rises as it scrolls into view.
notes: takes the text colour of its parent; the outline is that colour at 80%
the reveal is a CSS view timeline, off under reduced motion
name: helionenergy-button

props.name: reveal
props.description: draw the outline in from the middle and lift the label as the button scrolls into view
